_note: MeiliSearch retiré en v0.0.2 (commit 3b386a9). La recherche utilise désormais PostgreSQL directement. config/meilisearch.js supprimé.

postgresql_search.test_approach: Read-only PostgreSQL queries. All 6 search endpoints return 200 OK in production.

mailjet.test_approach: Dev mode fallback (no real emails sent). Verification codes logged to console/logs instead of emailed. Safe for testing email flow.
mailjet.reason: Service gracefully degrades to dev mode when credentials missing. No emails actually sent. Perfect for testing without real sends.

twilio.test_approach: Test mode fallback (no real SMS sent). Verification codes logged to console/logs instead of sent as SMS. Safe for testing phone verification.
twilio.reason: Service gracefully degrades to test mode when credentials missing. No SMS actually sent. Perfect for testing without real sends.

redis.test_approach: Health check only (PING command). Read-only, non-destructive verification of Redis connectivity. No cache modifications.
redis.reason: Health checks use PING only (non-destructive). No data modification needed to verify connectivity.
redis.production_status: ACTIVE - Production requirement (FATAL error if missing in production)

admin_routes: GET /api/admin/queues/:queueName/jobs (list jobs by status, auth required)
bull_queues.test_approach: Read-only stats endpoints and diagnostic health checks. No job modifications needed for connectivity testing.
bull_queues.reason: Health checks and stats retrieval are read-only. No jobs modified by diagnostics. Production jobs remain untouched.
bull_queues.production_status: ACTIVE - All 5+ queues actively processing jobs

env_vars: FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT (JSON env var or local file)
usage: Mobile push notifications (iOS, Android via Expo)
firebase_fcm.fallback_mechanism: Falls back to Expo push if FCM unavailable (/backend/config/push-notification-fallback.js)
firebase_fcm.test_approach: Initialization status check only. No actual push notifications sent during testing. Graceful disable if credentials missing.
firebase_fcm.reason: Service gracefully disables if credentials missing. Push fallback ensures app stability. No data modification.
firebase_fcm.production_status: NOT CONFIGURED in production .env (Expo fallback active)

sentry.test_approach: Passive monitoring only. No testing needed. Missing DSN is safe (logging disabled gracefully).
sentry.reason: Sentry is read-only monitoring. No data modification. If DSN missing, logging is disabled gracefully.

health_check.test_approach: Read-only diagnostic endpoint. Non-destructive verification of all services.
health_check.reason: Health checks use PING/ECHO commands only. No data modification.

monitoring.test_approach: Read-only metrics collection. Non-destructive performance monitoring.
monitoring.reason: Monitoring queries are passive. No data modification. Metrics collected from request/response inspection only.

summary.test_risk_level: LOW - Only read-only health checks and diagnostic endpoints
summary.reason_all_safe: All services implement graceful fallback modes when not configured. Health checks are non-destructive. Admin endpoints are read-only for stats. No data modification required for any test.
